response.text: Your goal is to build a two-way contact sync between HubSpot and a PostgreSQL users table so that new signups appear in HubSpot within 5 minutes, HubSpot lifecycle stage changes write back to PostgreSQL, recent updates win conflicts with logging, and the solution runs on your server with a maintenance README. Here is my plan: First, I will execute the kickoff and analysis of HubSpot and PostgreSQL schemas using Python. Second, I will develop the two-way sync script for new signups and lifecycle stages with recent-update conflict resolution and logging using Python, PostgreSQL, and HubSpot. I did nearly this for a small support team: about 300 emails a week sorted into 6 categories; low-confidence ones go to a person. What server environment and operating system are we deploying to? Let's discuss the full plan and get started.
